title: MicroLLM Lab – Try 7 tiny LLM's in the browser
summary: MicroLLM Lab is an interactive web experiment that allows users to run 7 different tiny language models directly in their browser without server-side processing. The project demonstrates the feasibility of client-side AI inference using WebAssembly and WebGPU technologies, making LLM experimentation accessible to anyone with a modern browser.
problem_solved: Removes the barrier of needing powerful GPU hardware or cloud services to experiment with small language models.
why_valuable: Democratizes AI experimentation by enabling anyone to test and compare multiple tiny LLMs instantly in-browser with zero setup required.
